description: Every Sarvam AI model on your terminal — translate, speak, transcribe, chat, and extract documents in 22 Indian languages, with a local history that compounds

tools.name: chat_completions
tools.description: Creates a model response for the given chat conversation. Serves sarvam-105b and sarvam-105b-conversations models. Supports streaming via server-sent events, tool calling, and structured outputs. Required: messages, model. Optional: frequency_penalty (default: 0), max_tokens (default: 2048), n (default: 1) (plus 11 more). Returns array of ChatCompletionsItem.

params.name: model
params.description: Chat model ID. sarvam-105b for complex reasoning, sarvam-105b-conversations for real-time voice workloads

params.name: reasoning_effort
params.description: Reasoning effort. Set to null to disable

params.name: stream
params.description: Stream the response via server-sent events

tools.name: doc-ai_digitise
tools.description: Creates and starts a digitisation job from files or pre-uploaded handles. Converts documents to machine-readable text with layout awareness. Runs asynchronously; poll status until terminal. Optional: file, language, model (plus 2 more). Returns the new DocAiStartJobResponse.

tools.name: doc-ai_download-url
tools.description: Returns a presigned URL to download the output of a completed doc-ai job. Required: job_id.

tools.name: doc-ai_extract
tools.description: Creates and starts an extract job from files or pre-uploaded handles. Extract pulls structured fields out of documents according to a schema. Exactly one of file and upload_ids must be provided; exactly one of schema and config_id is required. Runs asynchronously. Optional: classification, config_id, file (plus 5 more). Returns the new DocAiStartJobResponse.

params.name: schema
params.description: Inline extraction schema as a JSON string

tools.name: doc-ai_results
tools.description: Fetches the results of a completed doc-ai job, including extracted fields and annotations with confidence scores. Required: job_id. Returns the DocAiGetResultsResponse.

tools.name: doc-ai_status
tools.description: Polls the status of a doc-ai job until a terminal status (completed, partially_completed, failed, rejected). Required: job_id. Returns the DocAiJobStatusResponse.

tools.name: doc-ai_upload
tools.description: Creates a presigned URL to upload a document for doc-ai processing. Required: content_type, file_name. Returns the new DocAiPresignUploadResponse.

params.name: file_name
params.description: Name of the file to upload

tools.name: models_list
tools.description: Lists the model IDs this deployment currently serves. A model is only served where its backend is configured, so the list is environment-specific — fetch it rather than hardcoding IDs. Returns array of ModelsListItem. (public)

tools.name: speech-to-text_speech_to_text
tools.description: Transcribes speech to text in multiple Indian languages and English. Accepts an audio file via multipart form-data. Supports transcribe, translate, verbatim, translit, and codemix modes. Required: file. Optional: input_audio_codec, language_code, mode (default: transcribe) (plus 2 more). Returns the new SpeechToTextResponse.

params.name: file
params.description: Audio file to transcribe (WAV, MP3, AAC, OGG, FLAC, etc.)

params.name: input_audio_codec
params.description: Audio codec of the input file (required for PCM)

params.name: language_code
params.description: Language of the input audio. unknown enables auto-detect

params.name: with_timestamps
params.description: Include chunk-level timestamps in the response

tools.name: speech-to-text_stt-job-download
tools.description: Returns presigned download URLs for the output files of a completed batch speech-to-text job. Required: files, job_id.

tools.name: speech-to-text_stt-job-initiate
tools.description: Creates a new speech-to-text bulk job and returns a job UUID and storage details for processing multiple audio files. Optional: callback, job_parameters.

params.name: callback-auth-token
params.description: Authorization token for the callback URL

params.name: callback-url
params.description: Webhook URL to call on job completion

params.name: job-parameters-num-speakers
params.description: Number of speakers to detect (when diarization enabled)

tools.name: speech-to-text_stt-job-start
tools.description: Starts processing a speech-to-text bulk job after all audio files have been uploaded. Required: job_id. Returns array of SpeechToTextSttJobStartItem.

tools.name: speech-to-text_stt-job-status
tools.description: Returns the status of a batch speech-to-text job including per-file details and download information. Required: job_id.

tools.name: speech-to-text_stt-job-upload
tools.description: Generates presigned upload URLs for audio files that will be processed in a speech-to-text bulk job. Required: files, job_id. Returns the new FilesUploadResponse.

tools.name: text-lid_identify-language
tools.description: Identifies the language (e.g. hi-IN) and script (e.g. Devanagari) of the input text, supporting 10+ Indian languages and English. Required: input. Returns the new IdentifyLanguageResponse.

params.name: input
params.description: Text input for language and script identification. Max 1000 chars

tools.name: text-to-speech_create-pronunciation-dictionary
tools.description: Uploads a .json file to create a new pronunciation dictionary. Only supported by bulbul:v3. The returned dictionary_id can be passed as dict_id in text-to-speech requests. Required: file. Returns the new PronunciationDictionaryCreateResponse.

params.name: file
params.description: JSON file with a pronunciations key

tools.name: text-to-speech_delete-pronunciation-dictionary
tools.description: Deletes a pronunciation dictionary by ID. Required: dict_id. Returns the PronunciationDictionaryDeleteResponse. Destructive.

tools.name: text-to-speech_get-pronunciation-dictionary
tools.description: Fetches a single pronunciation dictionary by ID. Required: dict_id. Returns the PronunciationDictionaryGetResponse.

tools.name: text-to-speech_list-pronunciation-dictionaries
tools.description: Lists all pronunciation dictionaries for the user. Dictionaries define custom word pronunciations used by bulbul:v3 TTS. Returns array of TextToSpeechListPronunciationDictionariesItem.

tools.name: text-to-speech_stream
tools.description: Converts the input text into a streamed spoken audio response using the specified output codec (e.g. MP3). Returns binary audio. Required: text. Optional: dict_id, enable_cached_responses (default: false), enable_preprocessing (default: false) (plus 10 more).

params.name: text
params.description: Text to convert to speech. Max 3500 chars

tools.name: text-to-speech_text_to_speech
tools.description: Converts text into spoken audio. The output is a base64-encoded audio string (WAV by default) that must be decoded before use. Supports bulbul:v2 and bulbul:v3 models with 30+ voices. Required: language_code, text. Optional: dict_id, enable_cached_responses (default: false), enable_preprocessing (default: false) (plus 8 more). Returns array of string.

params.name: dict_id
params.description: Pronunciation dictionary ID to apply. bulbul:v3 only

params.name: enable_preprocessing
params.description: Normalize English words and numeric entities. bulbul:v2 only

params.name: model
params.description: TTS model. bulbul:v3 is the latest with 30+ voices

params.name: speaker
params.description: Speaker voice (lowercase). Default shubh for bulbul:v3, anushka for bulbul:v2

params.name: speech_sample_rate
params.description: Sample rate of the output audio

params.name: text
params.description: Text to convert to speech. Max 2500 chars for bulbul:v3, 1500 for bulbul:v2. Use commas for numbers larger than 4 digits

tools.name: text-to-speech_update-pronunciation-dictionary
tools.description: Updates an existing pronunciation dictionary with a new JSON file. Required: dict_id, file. Returns the updated PronunciationDictionaryUpdateResponse.

tools.name: translate_translate
tools.description: Converts text from one language to another while preserving meaning. Supports 22 Indic languages plus English. Required: input, source_language_code, target_language_code. Optional: mode (default: formal), model, numerals_format (default: international) (plus 2 more). Returns the new TranslateResponse.

params.name: input
params.description: Text to translate. Max 1000 chars for mayura:v1, 2000 for sarvam-translate:v1

params.name: mode
params.description: Tone or style of the translation. sarvam-translate:v1 only supports formal

params.name: model
params.description: Translation model. mayura:v1 supports 12 languages with all modes; sarvam-translate:v1 supports 22 languages, formal only

params.name: numerals_format
params.description: Numerals style (international 0-9 or native script numerals)

params.name: output_script
params.description: Transliteration style applied to output. mayura:v1 only

params.name: source_language_code
params.description: Source language. auto enables detection (mayura:v1 only)

params.name: speaker_gender
params.description: Gender of the speaker for better translations

tools.name: transliterate_transliterate
tools.description: Transliterates text from one script to another (e.g. Devanagari to Latin) while keeping the same language and pronunciation. Required: input, source_language_code, target_language_code. Optional: numerals_format (default: international), spoken_form (default: false), spoken_form_numerals_language (default: native). Returns the new TransliterateResponse.

params.name: spoken_form
params.description: Converts text into a natural spoken form

params.name: spoken_form_numerals_language
params.description: Language for numerals in spoken form
